input.quote: 2. Corio Customer Application Management Revenue: Corio to pay Commerce One [*] of all Application Management Revenue from Corio Customers for use of Commerce One Software or MarketSite.net Service Access subject to the following limitations.
input.rationale: We reviewed the fee and pricing provisions (Section 4, Exhibit B Pricing, Revenue Sharing Fees and Payment Terms), the grant of rights (Section 2, including the distribution licence and new products clauses), Shared Resources (Section 13) and the sales/marketing exhibit, and ran targeted searches for "most favored/favorable", "no less favorable", "best price", "lowest", "discount", "preferred" and "similar". The pricing and revenue-sharing terms are fixed figures and percentages with no obligation for Corio to extend Commerce One its most favourable pricing, margins or other terms, and no obligation to match any third-party offer. There is likewise no MFN running in Commerce One's favour elsewhere in the agreement. Consistent with the playbook (MFN in our favour is welcome; MFN burdening the Customer is not), no redline is required.
